description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic and mortality information for each patient in the dataset. It includes the patient's gender, date of birth, and multiple date of death records from different sources (hospital, social security, and a general patient table record), as well as an expire flag indicating patient mortality. The table uses `SUBJECT_ID` as a unique patient identifier.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each patient.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, either 'F' (female) or 'M' (male).

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The patient's date of birth.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The patient's date of death, if available.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: The patient's date of death recorded during hospitalization, if available.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: The patient's date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration, if available.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient has expired (1) or not (0).

description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual Intensive Care Unit (ICU) stays for patients. It links patient identifiers (SUBJECT_ID, HADM_ID) to specific ICU stay identifiers (ICUSTAY_ID) and records details such as the database source, first and last care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge timestamps (INTIME, OUTTIME), and the length of stay (LOS) in days. This table allows for analysis of patient movement and duration of stay within the ICU.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source where the data was obtained, e.g., 'metavision'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first ICU care unit the patient was admitted to, e.g., 'NICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last ICU care unit the patient was in during their stay, e.g., 'MICU', 'SICU'.

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient upon admission to the ICU.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at discharge from the ICU.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay in the ICU, in days.

description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information about hospital admissions for patients in the database. It includes patient identifiers, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, discharge locations, insurance details, demographic information (language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), diagnosis, and flags indicating in-hospital mortality and the availability of data in the CHARTEVENTS table. This table provides a comprehensive overview of each patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier, unique across the entire MIMIC-III database.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: The date and time of the patient's death, if it occurred during the hospital stay. Null if the patient did not die during the admission.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission, e.g., 'ELECTIVE', 'URGENT', 'EMERGENCY'.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the patient prior to admission.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location to which the patient was discharged (e.g., Home, Skilled Nursing Facility).

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: The type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language of the patient.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: The patient's self-identified religion.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: The patient's marital status.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: The patient's self-identified ethnicity.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was registered in the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient left the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The primary diagnosis for the patient's admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient expired in the hospital (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether or not the patient's admission has corresponding data in the CHARTEVENTS table (1) or not (0).
